items.title: Phil Woods — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Dave Frishberg does it real well; Bob Dorough does it real well,

ctx.x: So sometimes there’s a time to just be? We can search so much and find …

Well, I think you’ve got to find out who you are eventually, and find out what your strong suit is and stick with it. My strong suit is still playing songs. I still love uhm … there’s a set of two records that’s out now that’s my songs and my lyrics, of songs that I’ve composed over the past 50 years. And that’s starting to … that appeals to me. I’m doing more composing and uh adding lyrics, doing lyrics … as Benny Carter did. Benny Carter did songs and did his own lyrics and stuff. I’ reminded of when Cole…
